Welcome to the 2026 Tire Streets Drift Games Winter Bash, closing out the year on November 14th and 15th with one final blowout before winter fully sets in.

The Tire Streets Drift Games Winter Bash returns to Mondello Park for a full weekend of non-stop drifting and the last major chance of the year for drivers to blow off steam. In partnership with Tire Streets, this is where the season winds down the only way it should, with zero pressure, full commitment, and driving purely for the love of it. Two days of flat-out action across four layouts, passenger rides, and the unmistakable Bash atmosphere on and off track.

With over 150 drivers expected, the Winter Bash delivers relentless action across all four layouts. Expect wild insane drift trains, drivers sending it with nothing left to prove, and cars being driven exactly as they were built to be. From the main Mondello Park layouts to Sportsland, every track will be busy from start to finish as everyone makes the most of the final big event of the year.

The Winter Bash is the ultimate end-of-season send-off. 150 drivers and one last weekend to empty the tank before winter.

content.rendered:
Full of the Pipe Truck Show brings a full-throttle weekend celebrating everything on wheels, with a huge showcase of trucks ranging from vintage classics and custom builds to the very latest models. Explore the bustling Trade Village both indoors and outdoors, connect with main dealers, and soak up the atmosphere with a fun fair and live stage entertainment running throughout the event. It’s a must-visit for enthusiasts and families alike, with something happening around every corner. The show runs Saturday from 11am to 6pm and Sunday from 10am to 4pm.

Truck owners can take part in an extensive range of judging categories, covering everything from tractor units and rigids across multiple eras to specialised vehicles, fleets, and custom builds. Awards will be presented for standout areas like paintwork, lighting, graphics, and unique truck types, alongside categories for combinations, recovery vehicles, and construction trucks. The competition builds towards the ultimate prize, with one standout entry crowned Overall Truck of the Show.

Following a record-breaking 2025 edition, the event continues to grow, bringing together over 100 teams and 440 riders. From fundraising efforts to personal milestones and competitive goals, it’s the shared atmosphere and sense of achievement that make Jeep Mondello 24 such a memorable experience.

Rally, road, and sprint cars can take part in dedicated grip vs drifting sessions, rotating every 20 minutes on the full Mondello Park circuit.

Step back in time with the Historic Festival sponsored by Carole Nash, returning for 2026 as a standout celebration of classic motorsport and vintage car culture. As Ireland’s only dedicated historic motor racing event, it showcases an extraordinary collection of classic and vintage race cars, spanning from the refined elegance of the 1920s through to the unmistakable style and performance of the 1960s.

Hosted at Mondello Park, this unique event blends the thrill of live racing with the charm of a traditional classic car show. Spectators can experience historic machines in full flight on track, from pre-war racers to iconic saloons and GT cars, all preserved and presented in period-correct detail. Alongside the track action and  car show families can enjoy the free fun fair attractions, music and food area and trade stands.

2026 off-track highlights

Personal appearances by
Alex Dunne
Tim Shaw (Sunday only)
Derek Daly
Alec Poole
& up and coming Irish Racers Fionn McLaughlin and Alex O’Grady

2026 on-track highlights

F1 Demos
1995 Jordan 195 Peugeot
1992 Ex Michael Schumacher Benetton B192
1988 Arrows Megatron A10B
1978 Hesketh 308E
1995 Pacific PR02

Demonstration Laps
2 Ford C100’s on track together for the first time.
Historic Motorcycles, both 2 stroke and 4 stroke.

2026 Race Action
Pre 1966 Touring Cars
Historic Car Races
Pre 1955 car races

Ideal for motorsport fans, classic car lovers, and families alike, the event captures the spirit of a bygone era while delivering a full day of entertainment. The Historic Festival sponsored by Carole Nash remains one of Ireland’s most distinctive classic car shows, combining heritage, atmosphere, and on-track excitement in one unforgettable experience.

This winter gathering celebrates everything that defines JDM culture, from beautifully preserved classics to standout modified builds, all set against the backdrop of Ireland’s premier motorsport venue. With a strong community atmosphere, plenty of cars to admire, and the buzz of a new season getting underway, the January event is the perfect way to start the year for fans of Japanese performance and style.
